title: Analista de infraestrutura cloud pleno
description:
Buscamos um(a)Analista de Infraestrutura Cloud Plenosua missão é garantir que a aplicação tenha condições de ser executada adequadamente no ambiente do cliente. Você será protagonista no diagnóstico e apoio na resolução de problemas de desempenho de nossas aplicações no ambiente do cliente. Você precisa ser capaz de avaliar o dimensionamento da infraestrutura do cliente para o cenário atual e orientá-la para as demandas de curto e médio prazo do cliente. Esse trabalho é feito de forma colaborativa com o cliente, responsáveis pela infraestrutura (hardware, rede, SO e DB) dele, consultores das unidades, SD (Service Desk) e DTI (Diretoria de Tecnologia) da Sankhya.Aqui na Sankhya, acreditamos que crescimento e resultado andam juntos com parceria e propósito. Se você é movido por desafios, gosta de atuar de forma próxima aos clientes e quer construir uma carreira em um ecossistema de inovação, vem com a gente!Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES
Identificar os gargalos de desempenho de forma priorizada.
Passar esses gargalos para o cliente e/ou responsáveis pelo ambiente e/ou software, de forma oral, nos Tickets e/ou Relatórios de Diagnóstico.
Ser capaz de explicitar como os ofensores foram identificados.
Ser capaz de checar se eles foram adequadamente resolvidos.
Avaliar o dimensionamento da infraestrutura atual do cliente e mudanças de curto e médio prazo.
Propor adequações na infraestrutura, personalizações e/ou aplicações para que elas sejam capazes de atender as demandas de negócio do cliente sem gargalos.
Ser capaz de instalar e configurar o Sankhya Om no(s) servidor(es) de aplicações e de DB (Banco de Dados) do cliente, incluindo instalações em clúster.
Ser capaz de reconhecer inadequações numa instalação e/ou configuração.REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES
Graduação: Sistemas ou Redes ou DB (final de curso ou concluída).
Experiência intermediária em suporte, instalação e troubleshooting do Sankhya W (Sk W).
Experiência intermediária em Sistemas Operacionais (SO): Windows e Linux.
Experiência intermediária em Banco de Dados (DB): Oracle e SQL Server.
Experiência intermediária em instalação e troubleshooting em Servidor de Aplicação (Wild Fly do Sk W).
Experiência intermediária com ferramentas de troubleshooting de aplicações: Flight Recorder, AWR, Dump de Threads, Monitor de Consultas do Sk W, Tracert de Rede/SO/DB, etc.DIFERENCIAIS
Conhecimentos intermediários de rede e segurança.
Especialização: Sistemas ou Redes ou Database ou Segurança.
Inglês: Básico de leitura.LOCALIDADE
Uberlândia/MG – Presencial
São Paulo/SP – Híbrido (2x/semana no escritório)
Outras localidades – Remoto
▪️ Regime de contratação: CLTBENEFÍCIOS
Remuneração Variável + Participação nos Resultados (PPR)
Vale Alimentação/Refeição i Food
Plano de saúde
Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Estendida
Auxílio Creche

title: Api engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.We are looking forAPI Designer/Engineerwho wants to learn and transform his career.In this role you will: (responsibilities)Overview
The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.Key Responsibilities
API Design & Development
Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage Open API (Swagger), RAML, or Async API specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API Dev Ops framework.
Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.API Consumer Onboarding
Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/Open ID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.Testing & Validation
Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.Skills and Expertise
API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using Open API, Swagger Hub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, Open ID Connect, and API key management best practices.
Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman toolWhat can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.
• Opportunities to work outside Brazil
• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.What do we offer?TCS Benefits – Brazil:
Health insurance
Dental Plan
Life insurance
Transportation vouchers
Meal/Food Voucher
Childcare assistance
Gympass
TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
Partnership with SESC
Reimbursement of Certifications
Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
International experience opportunity
Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career PlatformAt TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!#BuildingonbeliefID:

title: Data scientist - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!What you will be doing:
You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.
Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems
What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment
What we offer:Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass
Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)Why you should join us
Artefact is the place to be:come and build the future of marketing
Progress:every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
Culture:join the best team you could ever imagine
Entrepreneurship:you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!
Come join us!

title: Data scientist - fluent english
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!What you will be doing:
You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.
Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems
What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment
What we offer:Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass
Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)Why you should join us
Artefact is the place to be:come and build the future of marketing
Progress:every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
Culture:join the best team you could ever imagine
Entrepreneurship:you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!
Come join us!

title: Data consultant brazil
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!What you will be doing
As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.
Innovate:You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
Learn and Share:You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You’ll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team’s evolution.
Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations:You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
Act Across the Project Value Chain:From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
Participate in Training:You’ll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team:You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.
What we are looking for
Academic Background:In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem : Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit : You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team.What We Offer:
Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass
Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)Why you should join us
Artefact is the place to be:come and build the future of marketing
Progress:every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
Culture:join the best team you could ever imagine
Entrepreneurship:you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!Come join us!

title: Principal ai engineer - ai in healthcare
description:
WHO WE AREWe are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:
Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
Automated coding and billing optimization
Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials
Seamless compliance with value-based care requirementsJoin us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOUThis is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.KEY RESPONSIBILITIESVery hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!1. Build and Refine AI Products
Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy
Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy3. Own the Development Lifecycle
Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement
Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge baseREQUIRED EXPERTISE1. Technical Skills
Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, Open AI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (Postgre SQL)2. Mindset & Approach
Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing3. Highly Valued Qualifications
Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, Git Hub Copilot, or similar
Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (Lang Chain, Llama Index, or similar)
Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle managementHealthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.WHAT WE OFFER1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity
Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale2. Professional Excellence
Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside3. Work-Life Integration
Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily
Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainabilityREADY FOR THE CHALLENGE?If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

title: Indirect tax manager
description:
About Us:
Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.We are seeking a proactive and experiencedTax BPto support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.Job description
The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.Desired profile
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
Knowledge in Tax reform;
Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;Language:
Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.

title: Client services, interpretation (language services | research | due diligence | remote)
description:
About Us
Cadence ( ) is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry. We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). We strive to promote internally whenever possible, so this is a limited opportunity to join a company that values ambitious and efficient professionals keen to develop their career.Key Responsibilities
You are a project manager for our interpretation team. Your job title would be Associate on our Client Service team. The full career track associated with this role can be seen onour careers page.You'll play a key role in ensuring clients' interpretation and market research needs are met with precision and efficiency. Your responsibilities will centre around three core areas: project management, client communication, and ad-hoc recruitment of specialized language professionals. As you master these core functions, opportunities may arise for managing more complex projects, assuming enhanced client-facing roles, and collaborating with Client Service Managers on strategic planning, furthering your growth within the Client Services team.Our interpretation team covers both remote projects and on-site projects.Note - this role is to manage interpretation projects, not to actually interpret on behalf of clients.The JobYou will manage multiple projects per day.Projects can begin and end on the same day (”I need an interpreter for a call at 8pm tonight”).Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).Here’s how you will interact with a project:Scoping
You will speak with clients via email, phone, or We Chat about their needs
You will work with colleagues to ensure the client’s expectations for quality, speed, and cost are met
You will identify colleagues to assist based on the relevant time zones or regions for the project
Matchmaking
Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective
You will need to present that linguists’ experience in a relevant way for the project
... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction
Executing
You will need to sync up expectations between client(s) and linguist(s)
You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied
Key RequirementsBachelor’s degree in a related field
Fluency in English. Fluency in an additional language is a bonus.
Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills
Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges
Entry-level to intermediate-level candidates are welcome to apply: any relevant work experience is a plusWorking Hours & LocationThis is afully-remote rolewhere you can work from home ( WFH )
You will work eitherAPAC, AMER or EMEA business hours , but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - Lat Am applicants will work AMER hours)
Weekends and overnights shifts are availablewith a commensurate increase in compensation.Compensation & Benefits
Salary commensurate with experience
Paid time off
Health insurance
Annual allowance for professional development expenses

title: Strategic executive assistant to the ceo
description:
The VisionAt AI Leadership, we believe in clarity, structure, and well-run operations that allow our team to focus on the work that creates the greatest impact. The Strategic EA role exists to provide end-to-end leverage to the CEO by owning tactical and operational execution: inbox, calendar, logistics, and meeting prep. We are looking for a "thinking partner" who can maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and brand representation.Who We’re Looking ForThe Strategic Executive Assistant (EA) will act as the CEO's "20% focus" unlock, allowing him to drive 80% of business outcomes. This is not a role for someone who only follows rigid rules; we need an individual who can operate with nuance, anticipate needs before they are stated, and understand the CEO's unique decision-making framework.
You will be measured on your ability to triage the CEO's inbox to 95% without escalation and reduce calendar friction to near-zero. If you are a high-nuance individual who "just gets it" and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.Why You Should Join UsAI Frontier : Gain direct exposure to the AI space and learn to build and refine AI-driven automation.
Career Growth : We are a growing organization that values internal mobility; this role has a path toward operations or management, as demonstrated by previous incumbents.
High-Impact Environment : Work alongside experienced leaders who prioritize growth, ambition, and proactive problem-solving.Role ResponsibilitiesThe 20% That Drives 80% of Success
Inbox Ownership : Manage the CEO's inbox end-to-end, responding to all messages within 24 hours using his tone and zero "emotional leakage".
Strategic Calendar Defense : Own the calendar to ensure it reflects strategic priorities; proactively identify gaps or blockers and coordinate with the family assistant to honor personal time.
Flawless Travel & Logistics : Execute end-to-end travel (flights, hotels, ground transport) and remain on-call for any transit issues.
Meeting Readiness : Maintain prep docs and ensure the CEO is fully prepared for every internal and external stakeholder interaction.
The Remaining 80%
Hub Spot & CRM Maintenance : Review deals weekly, ensure follow-up tasks are executed on time, and load new contacts sourced by the CEO.
SOP & Notion Management : Fully own and update all CEO-related workflows and databases, ensuring documentation is audit-ready and searchable.
Small-Scope Project Management : Lead projects assigned by the Exec Ops Manager, assessing needs, developing plans, and communicating status to stakeholders.Skills & Attributes We're Looking ForMethodical & Nuanced : You understand the difference between tactical execution and strategic decision-making and can operate independently in ambiguous situations.
1–3 Years of Relevant Experience : Ideally supporting senior leaders or working in high-growth, corporate, or communications-heavy environments.
Proactive Tech-Savviness : Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, Hub Spot (or similar CRMs), and Notion, plus a strong drive to use AI tools for speed and efficiency.
Executive Presence : You have a professional audio/video setup and communicate with the polish required for CEO-facing interactions.
Coachability : You believe feedback is the "breakfast of champions" and iterate quickly based on guidance.Our ValuesCreate remarkable experiences– Every interaction is a chance to satisfy customers and internal team members.
Always be growing– Committed to continuous improvement and individual learning.
Deliver results– Taking initiative to solve problems and drive success regardless of formal responsibility.
Do the right thing– Prioritizing integrity, respect, and discretion in all interactions.
Practice what we teach– Pushing the boundaries of what it means to be AI-driven.
Compensation & LocationCompensation : Starts at $2,200 USD
Location : Remote (Working within 8 AM - 5 PM CST is preferred).Application & Selection ProcessTO APPLY:
Send your Resume(PDF titled "Lastname. Firstname. EA.pdf") to (Operations+ ).
Record a short demo video(2 - 4 mins max) highlighting your relevant experience for the role, skills, successes, and goals for the future. Also, we’d like you to briefly mention the following insights:Process Optimization Proposal:Share an example of how you’ve improved an operational workflow in the past (Preferably using AI or automation tools). We want you to showcase your personality, and why you believe you are the ideal candidate for the Strategic Executive Assistant role.

Experiência anterior em desenvolvimento de negócios, vendas B2 B ou gestão de parcerias estratégicas.
Conhecimento de análise de mercado, tendências e cenário competitivo.
Proficiência em ferramentas de CRM e software de gestão comercial.
Inglês avançado.

Experiência anterior na área comercial de consultoria - desejável.Outras habilidades:Fortes habilidades de negociação para estabelecer acordos comerciais vantajosos.
Capacidade de construir parcerias estratégicas e identificar oportunidades de crescimento.
Mentalidade analítica para apresentar estudos de caso e análises de viabilidade à liderança.
Orientado para resultados, com foco em metas comerciais e satisfação do cliente.Com mais de 4.000 funcionários em mais de 30 países, a diversidade na GP Strategies é uma segunda natureza! Além de nossas localidades, nossa cultura se concentra no desempenho e gira em torno do respeito, da justiça e do trabalho colaborativo para atingir nossos objetivos. É assim que nascem as grandes ideias, que nos permitem trabalhar de forma mais inteligente.

title: Data analyst
description:

title: Senior software engineer
description:
Teachableis a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!What is the role?
We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.In this role you'll:

Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.What You’ll Bring:
3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.Nice to have:
Golang experienceThis is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

This is not a role for someone who only follows rigid rules; we need an individual who can operate with nuance, anticipate needs before they are stated, and understand the CEO's unique decision-making framework.

Flawless Travel & Logistics : Execute end-to-end travel (flights, hotels, ground transport) and remain on-call for any transit issues.
Meeting Readiness : Maintain prep docs and ensure the CEO is fully prepared for every internal and external stakeholder interaction.
The Remaining 80%
Hub Spot & CRM Maintenance : Review deals weekly, ensure follow-up tasks are executed on time, and load new contacts sourced by the CEO.
SOP & Notion Management : Fully own and update all CEO-related workflows and databases, ensuring documentation is audit-ready and searchable.
Small-Scope Project Management : Lead projects assigned by the Exec Ops Manager, assessing needs, developing plans, and communicating status to stakeholders.Skills & Attributes We're Looking ForMethodical & Nuanced : You understand the difference between tactical execution and strategic decision-making and can operate independently in ambiguous situations.
1–3 Years of Relevant Experience : Ideally supporting senior leaders or working in high-growth, corporate, or communications-heavy environments.
Proactive Tech-Savviness : Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, Hub Spot (or similar CRMs), and Notion, plus a strong drive to use AI tools for speed and efficiency.
Executive Presence : You have a professional audio/video setup and communicate with the polish required for CEO-facing interactions.
Coachability : You believe feedback is the \"breakfast of champions\" and iterate quickly based on guidance.Our ValuesCreate remarkable experiences– Every interaction is a chance to satisfy customers and internal team members.
Always be growing– Committed to continuous improvement and individual learning.
Deliver results– Taking initiative to solve problems and drive success regardless of formal responsibility.
Do the right thing– Prioritizing integrity, respect, and discretion in all interactions.
Practice what we teach– Pushing the boundaries of what it means to be AI-driven.

Location : Remote (Working within 8 AM - 5 PM CST is preferred).Application & Selection ProcessTO APPLY:

title: Engenheiro(a) de software sênior – inteligência artificial, cloud e automação (clt) - remoto
description:
Estamos em busca de umaPessoa Engenheira de Software Sênioraltamente capacitada para integrar nossa equipe e atuar como referência técnica emMachine Learning (ML), IA Generativa e Automação. Esta é uma oportunidade para profissionais que desejam ir além, moldar o futuro dos nossos produtos e desbloquear o potencial de um time remoto, autônomo e vibrante.Você chegará em um momento crucial da empresa, onde a experiência em lidar com sistemas em evolução e a capacidade de inovar em um ambiente cloud-centric (AWS) são diferenciais.Acreditamos em um senso de grupo forte e na autonomia das equipes para entregar valor.O Gran é um ecossistema que uneeducaçãoetecnologia , que acelera e customiza o aprendizado para diferentes necessidades e momentos e que já impactou mais de 2 milhões de vidas. Temos a plataforma de educação mais acessada do Brasil e fomos eleitos a 5ª empresa mais inovadora da América Latina.Hoje, temos 2 verticais principais:a de Cursos Preparatórios e a Gran Faculdade.Adotamos iniciativas tecnológicas para deixar a educação mais inclusiva. Por isso, temos atualmente vários produtos para fazer isso acontecer, como: os audiolivros – com técnicas avançadas de inteligência artificial, criamos um acervo com mais de 28 mil livros convertidos em 110 mil horas de áudio –; o Gerenciador de Estudos, que auxilia no planejamento diário; e os aplicativos para TV e celulares Android e i OS, que funcionam também no modo offline.Recursos tecnológicos e inovação nos acompanham desde sempre e, com o esforço do nosso time, fomos reconhecidos mundialmente pelaAmazon Web Servicescom três cases de sucesso envolvendoInteligência Artificial , boas práticas, inovação, inclusão e impacto.Acesse nossos cases clicando nos links abaixo:➡ 20 mil horas de vídeo legendadas com mais de 92% de precisão;
➡ Recomendação de cursos utilizando Amazon Sage Maker;
➡ Audiolivros.Se interessou? Vem serGran Lover !
Esta vaga está no nosso modelo de trabalhoGran Mundo , sendo100% remoto.
Todas as nossas vagas são no modelo de trabalho CLT.Quer saber mais sobre a gente? Clique AQUI para retornar para a página de carreiras.Responsabilidades e atribuiçõesO seu desafio como Senior AI Engineer:
Você será o pilar de engenharia da Tribo de Dados & IA. Sua missão vai muito além de codar: esperamos que você transforme protótipos de IA em produtos de software robustos, escaláveis e observáveis. Você será a referência técnica para garantir que nossas soluções (como assistentes jurídicos e sistemas de extração de dados) funcionem em produção com alta disponibilidade.Suas principais responsabilidades:
Engenharia de Sistemas de IA (AI Engineering):
Arquitetar e desenvolver o backend de aplicações baseadas em LLMs, garantindo que elas sejam rápidas, custo-eficientes e confiáveis.
Implementar pipelines de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) de ponta a ponta, cuidando desde a ingestão e chunking inteligente de dados até a estratégia de recuperação e geração de resposta.
Criar e manter Agentes Autônomos que realizam tarefas complexas, garantindo que tenham mecanismos de controle, memória e tratamento de erros (para evitar loops infinitos ou alucinações).Liderança Técnica “Hands-on”:
Atuar como Tech Lead natural da squad: liderar definições de arquitetura, conduzir Code Reviews rigorosos (focados em design patterns e performance) e elevar a barra técnica do time.
Mentorar engenheiros plenos e juniores através de pair programming e discussões técnicas, ajudando a desbloquear problemas complexos do dia a dia.Excelência Operacional & Cloud (AWS):
Assumir a propriedade da infraestrutura das suas aplicações (“You build it, you run it”). Isso inclui saber arquitetar soluções na AWS e otimizar custos de inferência.
Garantir a observabilidade total dos sistemas: implementar logs estruturados, métricas e tracing (para debugar cadeias de Lang Chain/agentes em produção).Automação Inteligente:
Desenvolver crawlers e bots robustos para captura de dados em larga escala, integrando essas automações diretamente com nossos pipelines de IA para enriquecimento de dados em tempo real.Colaboração e Produto:
Trabalhar lado a lado com Product Managers e Designers para traduzir problemas de negócio vagos em soluções técnicas viáveis.
Ter a autonomia para questionar requisitos, propor simplificações e defender a qualidade do software contra prazos irrealistas (negociando débito técnico de forma consciente).Requisitos e qualificaçõesO que buscamos (Hard Skills & Ferramentas):
Para essa cadeira, buscamos um perfil de Engenharia de Software (Backend) com especialização em IA Generativa. Não procuramos apenas quem “consome APIs”, mas quem constrói sistemas resilientes ao redor delas.
Python Moderno & Engenharia Robusta:
Proficiência avançada em Python.
Domínio de Pydantic para validação de dados e Fast API para construção de APIs assíncronas de alto desempenho.
Experiência com gerenciamento profissional de pacotes (Poetry ou uv) e ferramentas de qualidade de código.
Arquitetura de IA Generativa & Agentes:
Experiência sólida na construção de fluxos de IA com Lang Chain e, preferencialmente, orquestração de estado com Lang Graph.
Capacidade de desenhar e implementar arquiteturas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) que vão além do básico: conhecimento prático de Hybrid Search (Vetorial + Keyword) e estratégias de Reranking (ex: Cohere, BGE) para garantir precisão.
Engenharia de Software & Cloud (AWS):
Mentalidade de “You build it, you run it”. Experiência provisionando e mantendo infraestrutura em AWS (ECS, Lambda, SQS).
Domínio de Docker e familiaridade com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform ou CDK).
Design de sistemas distribuídos e orientados a eventos (Event-driven), essenciais para lidar com fluxos de agentes assíncronos.
Automação & Extração de Dados:
Experiência com frameworks de automação de browser (foco em Playwright Async) para tarefas complexas de extração de dados e interação com sistemas legados.Qualificação Necessária:
Experiência: Pelo menos 5+ anos de experiência prática em desenvolvimento de software (Backend), com os últimos anos focados ou transicionando para projetos de IA/Dados.
Formação: Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas (ou experiência prática equivalente comprovada).
Metodologia: Vivência real em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) com foco em entrega contínua.Diferenciais (O que faz seus olhos brilharem):
Se você tiver estes conhecimentos, você estará um passo à frente para liderar nossas iniciativas mais ambiciosas:
Sistemas Multi-Agentes (MAS): Experiência prática construindo sistemas onde múltiplos agentes colaboram autonomamente. Familiaridade com Google ADK ou padrões agênticos como Re Act, Plan-and-Execute e loops de auto-correção (Reflection).
RAG de Próxima Geração: Conhecimento ou interesse em Graph RAG (uso de Knowledge Graphs para capturar relacionamentos complexos) e Self-RAG (agentes que avaliam a própria recuperação).
Otimização de LLMs & SLMs:
Experiência rodando modelos locais (Phi-3, Llama-3, Gemma) para otimização de custos.
Uso de DSPy para otimização programática de prompts (substituindo a engenharia de prompt manual).
Avaliação de modelos (LLM-as-a-Judge) com frameworks como Ragas ou Deep Eval.
Ecossistema Web: Conhecimento em Node.js/Typescript ;para eventuais manutenções em interfaces ou integração com BFFs.Informações adicionais

title: Controls engineer
description:
Build the Future of Automation as aRobotics Controls EngineerWe’re looking for aRobotics Controls Engineerwho’s ready to take the lead in designing, programming, and optimizing cutting-edge robotic automation systems. In this hands-on role, you’ll bring bespoke robotic solutions to life, developing advanced control algorithms, integrating real-time systems, and delivering precision, performance, and reliability across industrial robot applications.You’ll work side by side with mechanical, electrical, and production teams to create fully integrated automation solutions from concept to commissioning. From running simulations and performance testing to solving complex control challenges, your expertise will directly shape innovative, high-impact systems used in real-world environments.This is an exciting opportunity for a controls engineer with 3+ years of industrial robot programming experience, a deep passion for automation, and the drive to push the boundaries of what robotic systems can achieve. If you’re eager to make a tangible impact on next-generation robotics, and see your work in action, this role is for you.Key ResponsibilitiesDevelop, implement, and optimise control algorithms for bespoke robotic systems.
Design and integrate control systems for real-time operation, ensuring precise and efficient movement, sensing, and interaction.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including mechanical design engineers, control engineers, and the production teams, to ensure seamless integration into our bespoke robotic automation & control systems.
Conduct simulations and testing to validate control algorithms, mechanical design, manipulator suitability and optimise performance to meet cycle time commitments.
Troubleshoot and resolve control system issues, ensuring smooth operation and reliability.
Stay updated with the latest advancements in robotics controls across multiple vendor platforms and identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.
Document design processes, specifications, and develop technical reports.Qualifications:Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
3+ years experience with programming industrial robots is essential.
Strong background in robotics controls and demonstrated experience in developing control algorithms for robotic systems, experience with programming ABB robots is essential.
Familiarity and experience with robotic hardware platforms, PLC programming (Rockwell, Siemens, Omron etc), sensors, and actuators.
Solid understanding of control theory, including PID control, state-space control, and adaptive control.
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex control system issues.
Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in cross functional teams.
Experience with industrial automation, machine vision, or motion planning is desirable.

Por isso, temos atualmente vários produtos para fazer isso acontecer, como: os audiolivros – com técnicas avançadas de inteligência artificial, criamos um acervo com mais de 28 mil livros convertidos em 110 mil horas de áudio –; o Gerenciador de Estudos, que auxilia no planejamento diário; e os aplicativos para TV e celulares Android e i OS, que funcionam também no modo offline.Recursos tecnológicos e inovação nos acompanham desde sempre e, com o esforço do nosso time, fomos reconhecidos mundialmente pelaAmazon Web Servicescom três cases de sucesso envolvendoInteligência Artificial , boas práticas, inovação, inclusão e impacto.Acesse nossos cases clicando nos links abaixo:➡ 20 mil horas de vídeo legendadas com mais de 92% de precisão;

Todas as nossas vagas são no modelo de trabalho CLT.Quer saber mais sobre a gente? Clique AQUI para retornar para a página de carreiras.Responsabilidades e atribuiçõesO seu desafio como Senior AI Engineer:
Você será o pilar de engenharia da Tribo de Dados & IA. Sua missão vai muito além de codar: esperamos que você transforme protótipos de IA em produtos de software robustos, escaláveis e observáveis. Você será a referência técnica para garantir que nossas soluções (como assistentes jurídicos e sistemas de extração de dados) funcionem em produção com alta disponibilidade.Suas principais responsabilidades:
Engenharia de Sistemas de IA (AI Engineering):
Arquitetar e desenvolver o backend de aplicações baseadas em LLMs, garantindo que elas sejam rápidas, custo-eficientes e confiáveis.
Implementar pipelines de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) de ponta a ponta, cuidando desde a ingestão e chunking inteligente de dados até a estratégia de recuperação e geração de resposta.
Criar e manter Agentes Autônomos que realizam tarefas complexas, garantindo que tenham mecanismos de controle, memória e tratamento de erros (para evitar loops infinitos ou alucinações).Liderança Técnica “Hands-on”:
Atuar como Tech Lead natural da squad: liderar definições de arquitetura, conduzir Code Reviews rigorosos (focados em design patterns e performance) e elevar a barra técnica do time.
Mentorar engenheiros plenos e juniores através de pair programming e discussões técnicas, ajudando a desbloquear problemas complexos do dia a dia.Excelência Operacional & Cloud (AWS):
Assumir a propriedade da infraestrutura das suas aplicações (“You build it, you run it”). Isso inclui saber arquitetar soluções na AWS e otimizar custos de inferência.
Garantir a observabilidade total dos sistemas: implementar logs estruturados, métricas e tracing (para debugar cadeias de Lang Chain/agentes em produção).Automação Inteligente:
Desenvolver crawlers e bots robustos para captura de dados em larga escala, integrando essas automações diretamente com nossos pipelines de IA para enriquecimento de dados em tempo real.Colaboração e Produto:
Trabalhar lado a lado com Product Managers e Designers para traduzir problemas de negócio vagos em soluções técnicas viáveis.
Ter a autonomia para questionar requisitos, propor simplificações e defender a qualidade do software contra prazos irrealistas (negociando débito técnico de forma consciente).Requisitos e qualificaçõesO que buscamos (Hard Skills & Ferramentas):
Para essa cadeira, buscamos um perfil de Engenharia de Software (Backend) com especialização em IA Generativa. Não procuramos apenas quem “consome APIs”, mas quem constrói sistemas resilientes ao redor delas.
Python Moderno & Engenharia Robusta:
Proficiência avançada em Python.
Domínio de Pydantic para validação de dados e Fast API para construção de APIs assíncronas de alto desempenho.
Experiência com gerenciamento profissional de pacotes (Poetry ou uv) e ferramentas de qualidade de código.
Arquitetura de IA Generativa & Agentes:
Experiência sólida na construção de fluxos de IA com Lang Chain e, preferencialmente, orquestração de estado com Lang Graph.
Capacidade de desenhar e implementar arquiteturas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) que vão além do básico: conhecimento prático de Hybrid Search (Vetorial + Keyword) e estratégias de Reranking (ex: Cohere, BGE) para garantir precisão.
Engenharia de Software & Cloud (AWS):
Mentalidade de “You build it, you run it”. Experiência provisionando e mantendo infraestrutura em AWS (ECS, Lambda, SQS).
Domínio de Docker e familiaridade com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform ou CDK).
Design de sistemas distribuídos e orientados a eventos (Event-driven), essenciais para lidar com fluxos de agentes assíncronos.
Automação & Extração de Dados:
Experiência com frameworks de automação de browser (foco em Playwright Async) para tarefas complexas de extração de dados e interação com sistemas legados.Qualificação Necessária:
Experiência: Pelo menos 5+ anos de experiência prática em desenvolvimento de software (Backend), com os últimos anos focados ou transicionando para projetos de IA/Dados.
Formação: Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas (ou experiência prática equivalente comprovada).
Metodologia: Vivência real em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) com foco em entrega contínua.Diferenciais (O que faz seus olhos brilharem):
Se você tiver estes conhecimentos, você estará um passo à frente para liderar nossas iniciativas mais ambiciosas:
Sistemas Multi-Agentes (MAS): Experiência prática construindo sistemas onde múltiplos agentes colaboram autonomamente. Familiaridade com Google ADK ou padrões agênticos como Re Act, Plan-and-Execute e loops de auto-correção (Reflection).
RAG de Próxima Geração: Conhecimento ou interesse em Graph RAG (uso de Knowledge Graphs para capturar relacionamentos complexos) e Self-RAG (agentes que avaliam a própria recuperação).
Otimização de LLMs & SLMs:
Experiência rodando modelos locais (Phi-3, Llama-3, Gemma) para otimização de custos.
Uso de DSPy para otimização programática de prompts (substituindo a engenharia de prompt manual).
Avaliação de modelos (LLM-as-a-Judge) com frameworks como Ragas ou Deep Eval.
Ecossistema Web: Conhecimento em Node.js/Typescript ;para eventuais manutenções em interfaces ou integração com BFFs.Informações adicionais

title: Accounting manager
description:
TGG Way Accounting Manager
Location:Fully Remote working for US-Based ClientsAbout Us
We are a dynamic and growing accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.TheAccounting Manager (AM)is an expert responsible for overseeing financial accounting and transaction processing. They serve as ambassadors ofTGG Way™ and US GAAP accounting standards. Accounting Managers provide100% accurate and complete financial statementsto Controllers. They play a key role intraining and mentoring staff(both internal and external) on internal controls, systems, and processes following theTGG Way™.
Additionally, Accounting Managers act as abridge between TGG and the client , ensuring continuous communication, implementing processes, addressing client needs, and relaying key information to other team members.Key ResponsibilitiesMonth-End Close & Core Accounting
Prepare and review journal entries and account reconciliations
Support the month-end close process following established checklists
Review P&L and balance sheet for accuracy before submission to the Controller
Maintain organized supporting documentation and workpapers
Financial Reporting
Prepare monthly financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow)
Perform basic variance analysis and flag inconsistencies
Ensure consistency and accuracy across financial reports and schedules
Accounting Operations
Review AP, AR, and credit card reconciliations
Support payroll processing and review prior to submission
Maintain and review the chart of accounts
Assist with recurring weekly and monthly accounting processes
Team Support & Review
Review work prepared by junior accountants or bookkeepers
Provide guidance, feedback, and basic training as needed
Ensure data accuracy and adherence to internal processes
Client & Internal Collaboration
Communicate with internal team members regarding open items and deadlines
Support client requests and questions under Controller supervision
Identify process improvement opportunities and escalate recommendationsRequirements
4+ years of accounting experience
Experience working with U. S.-based clients and exposure to U. S. GAAP
Strong understanding of month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations
Proficiency in Quick Books Online or Net Suite (preferred)
Strong Excel skills (formulas, data organization, basic analysis)
Fluent English (written and spoken)
Accounting or Finance degree
Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment
Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.
Can work US Timezone schedules (such as PST, EST)Compensation & Benefits
USD 2,500–3,500 per month , based on experience
Fully remoterole with some flexibility included
Paid training in U. S. GAAP and internal processes
Access to TGG University and learning resources
Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm
Unlimited PTO after onboarding period (holidays included)Notes:
This position is to join us as Independent Contractor
Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day)
Working Equipment to start is required
PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leaveAbout TGG Accounting
At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U. S. and around the world, in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.Our Core Values:
Loyalty
Integrity
Strong Work Ethic
Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
Team Player / Caring / Selfless
Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
Freedom & Accountability

title: Executivo (a) comercial externo
description:
Executivo(a) Comercial | Transforme o Setor de Energia com a Gente!
⚡ Sobre a Liora: Descomplicando a energia no Brasil
Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança.
A Liora chegou para mudar essa realidade. Nossa missão é provar que é possível ter acesso a uma energia mais barata e limpa com transparência, simplicidade e um atendimento genuinamente humano. Para nós, energia não é um produto técnico, é uma relação de confiança que devolve o poder para quem paga a conta.
Essa transformação é construída por um time obcecado por seus clientes e que busca a excelência em tudo o que faz. Se você busca um propósito, quer construir algo gigante e acredita que o impossível é o nosso ponto de partida, seu lugar é aqui
Sua Missão: Ser a Ponte Para um Futuro Energético Mais Justo

Sua principal missão será levar a solução da Liora para pequenas e médias empresas e clientes residenciais que mais sentem o impacto da conta de luz no bolso e ainda não sabem que têm uma alternativa melhor.

Despertar o mercado para uma nova realidade energética.
Ajudar clientes a tomar decisões com segurança e clareza.
Construir relações de confiança que duram.

️Desbravar o Mercado: Prospectar ativamente e qualificar novos clientes (PMEs e Residenciais), construindo um pipeline de oportunidades sólido e constante.

You will own a portfolio of high-potential creators and drive retention, growth, and expansion by acting as a strategic and tactical advisor. Engage directly and hands-on with creators across your portfolio, flexing between high-touch 1:1 support and scalable engagement models as needed. You will help design, run, and iterate on scalable initiatives (e.g. group coaching, campaigns, enablement content) as we continue to evolve our engagement playbooks.

Work cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, PMM, Sales, Support, Data, and Revenue Operations to surface customer insights, align on priorities, and influence decisions that improve the end-to-end creator experience.
Actively contribute to the evolution of our Customer Success function by identifying patterns across your portfolio, testing new approaches, documenting what works (and what doesn’t), and translating individual insights into repeatable motions for the broader team.Must haves:
4+ years of experience owning a book of business in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, or Business Development, with direct responsibility for retention, expansion, or revenue outcomes, beyond relationship maintenance
Experience managing a portfolio where growth was not guaranteed, requiring you to diagnose why accounts were plateauing and to take ownership of changing those outcomes
Proven ability to advise customers running complex businesses, with multiple stakeholders and unclear paths to growth, translating ambiguity into clear priorities and execution plans
Demonstrated comfort operating across high-touch and scaled engagement models, including knowing when to go deep 1:1 and when to drive impact through programs, campaigns, or enablement
Ability to develop a clear point of view, challenge customer assumptions, and influence decisions
Track record of turning incomplete data and weak signals into structured action plans, and following through to drive measurable business results
Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience using customer, revenue, and product data to identify risks, opportunities, and concrete levers for growth
Practical experience using CRM and analytics tools to actively manage, prioritize, and evolve a portfolio strategy
Fluent in English, with confidence leading both strategic and tactical conversations (all of your portfolio will speak english)Nice to haves:
Experience working with founders, creators, or entrepreneurs who own both strategy and execution of their businesses
Background in growth, monetization, or go-to-market strategy, particularly in digital or Saa S businesses
Experience designing, running, or iterating on scaled Customer Success motions (programs, group coaching, campaigns, enablement) alongside 1:1 engagementYou’ll be a great fit for this role if you:
Enjoy aproactive, growth-oriented Customer Success role , where you go beyond relationship maintenance and actively identify opportunities to drive customer impact
Thrive in adynamic environment , managing evolving portfolios and adapting your engagement approach as customer needs change
Prefer working withautonomy and judgment , using your experience to make decisions rather than relying solely on rigid playbooksThis is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.

Make a direct impact by designing and delivering learning programs that develop global talent, accelerate careers, and drive organizational success.
Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.

Hands-on experience with Quick Books and ERP systems
Katana experience is a strong plus
Proven ability to build and scale processes in a growing or entrepreneurial environment
Available to work in US time zones (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
Available to start within 2 weeks from job offerTechnical Requirements:

title: Partner manager
description:
A No Ping é uma plataforma de melhoria de conexão e performance para gamers, focada em reduzir ping, packet loss e aumentar FPS em jogos online.
Estamos montando um time comercial de alta performance para expandir nossa base de influenciadores ao redor do mundo.Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar como *SDR Hunter*, focada em prospecção, qualificação e primeiro contato com streamers, criadores de conteúdo e parceiros estratégicos.

* Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal em português
* Perfil proativo, organizado e orientado a metas e resultados
* Facilidade para abordar pessoas, iniciar conversas e fazer follow up
* Conhecimento do universo gamer: jogos online, streamers, plataformas de live e conteúdo
* Noção básica de vendas, funil comercial, prospecção ou atendimento ao cliente
* Capacidade de trabalhar com alto volume de contatos diariamente
* Disponibilidade para trabalho remoto em horário comercial do Brasil, com alguma flexibilidade para falar com criadores de outros fusos⭐ *Diferenciais** Experiência prévia como SDR, pré vendas, comercial ou parcerias
* Experiência com influenciadores, afiliados, times de e sports ou agências de creators
* Familiaridade com plataformas como Twitch, You Tube, Kick, Tik Tok, Instagram, X, Discord e comunidades de jogos

* Já ter trabalhado com produtos para gamers, Saa S ou tecnologia*O que oferecemos** Ambiente dinâmico, 100 por cento remoto e totalmente conectado ao mundo gamer
* Contato diário com streamers, criadores de conteúdo e comunidades de jogos do mundo todo
* Metas claras, plano de crescimento na área comercial e possibilidade de evoluir para posições seniores
* Remuneração fixa compatível com o mercado
* Variável agressivo por performance, com bônus semanais atrelados a metas de novos influenciadores e resultados da base

title: Data engineer
description:
What is Teachable?
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.
Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the globalHotmart Companyportfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!About your Team
At Teachable, our Data Team is all about getting things done with minimal overhead. We work closely together, sharing ideas, designing efficient systems, and building a robust data platform that supports the entire organization. Reporting to the Data Engineering Manager, you’ll take the lead on key initiatives, from optimizing our data platform to shaping the future of our events pipeline and ETL processes.
Our data infrastructure is primarily hosted on AWS. We leverage managed Airflow for orchestration, managed Kafka for event collection, Redshift for analytics, and S3 for data lake storage. Working as a Mid-level Analyst, you will partner with Finance to build metrics and data models that facilitate data exploration and business logic integration, supporting the continuous improvement of the data platform.The Impact You'll Make
In this role, you'll be at the heart of our data strategy, taking ownership of mission-critical infrastructure that supports teams across the company. You’ll also have the opportunity to make strategic recommendations on how we can evolve our data platform to stay ahead of the curve.What You’ll Do
Partner with Engineering and Product teams on high-impact initiatives.
Design and implement robust data pipelines using AWS services.
Enhance event collection, queueing, and processing mechanisms.
Build and refine meaningful alerts with automated corrective actions.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues, ensuring system reliability and stability.
Architect scalable data products with long-term vision and efficiency in mind.
Identify and resolve complex technical challenges involving system integration, infrastructure, and software bugs.About You
2-3+ years of experience in Data Engineering
Fluency in English is required
Strong knowledge of modern data engineering practices and software engineering principles
Solid experience with cloud infrastructure, especially AWS data services
Advanced understanding of relational data modeling
Strong SQL skills and Python for data wrangling
Hands-on experience withdata laketechnologies (Delta Lake, Hudi, or Iceberg)
Experience working with large-scale data warehouses (e.g., Redshift)
Experience integrating with RESTful APIs and webhooks
Familiarity with Dev Ops practices, Git version control, and clean coding standards
Exposure to monitoring and incident management tools (e.g., Cloud Watch, New Relic, Pager Duty)
Collaborative team player who values diversity and cross-functional collaborationNice to have:
Experience with Infrastructure asCode (Terraform )
Experience building and orchestrating data pipelines usingAirflowandSparkThis is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.

title: Javascript engineer — 3d web developer

Liderar tecnicamente iniciativas de AI de ponta a ponta, desde a exploração (discovery, spikes, POCs) até a implantação em produção e evolução contínua;
Trabalhar próximo de Produto, Dados, Operações, Marketing e demais times de Engenharia para identificar oportunidades reais de uso de AI que gerem impacto em receita, eficiência e experiência do cliente;
Apoiar a construção de produtos como chatbots executivos, copilotos internos, soluções de automação operacional e modelos de recomendação, sempre com foco em geração de valor mensurável;

Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, da concepção de produto e da arquitetura de soluções, garantindo coerência entre requisitos funcionais, não-funcionais e as capacidades dos modelos;
Incentivar documentação técnica clara (arquitetura, decisões, modelos, pipelines) e promover melhoria contínua no nosso codebase e na nossa plataforma de AI.Nos preocupamos com coerência, segurança e responsabilidade no uso de AI. Forte base em arquitetura e design de software (Domain-Driven Design, design de APIs, event-driven, microsserviços etc.);

title: Senior software engineer
description:
Teachableis a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!What is the role?
We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.In this role you'll:
Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.What You’ll Bring:
3+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.Nice to have:
Golang experienceThis is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Infraestrutura em AWS.

Repositórios no Git Hub.
Intelli J Ultimate como IDE.

description:
