title: Data engineer
description:
What is Teachable?
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.
Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!About your Team
At Teachable, our Data Team is all about getting things done with minimal overhead. We work closely together, sharing ideas, designing efficient systems, and building a robust data platform that supports the entire organization. Reporting to the Data Engineering Manager, you’ll take the lead on key initiatives, from optimizing our data platform to shaping the future of our events pipeline and ETL processes.
Our data infrastructure is primarily hosted on AWS. We leverage managed Airflow for orchestration, managed Kafka for event collection, Redshift for analytics, and S3 for data lake storage. Working as a Mid-level Analyst, you will partner with Finance to build metrics and data models that facilitate data exploration and business logic integration, supporting the continuous improvement of the data platform.The Impact You'll Make
In this role, you'll be at the heart of our data strategy, taking ownership of mission-critical infrastructure that supports teams across the company. You’ll also have the opportunity to make strategic recommendations on how we can evolve our data platform to stay ahead of the curve.What You’ll Do
Partner with Engineering and Product teams on high-impact initiatives.
Design and implement robust data pipelines using AWS services.
Enhance event collection, queueing, and processing mechanisms.
Build and refine meaningful alerts with automated corrective actions.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues, ensuring system reliability and stability.
Architect scalable data products with long-term vision and efficiency in mind.
Identify and resolve complex technical challenges involving system integration, infrastructure, and software bugs.About You
2-3+ years of experience in Data Engineering
Fluency in English is required
Strong knowledge of modern data engineering practices and software engineering principles
Solid experience with cloud infrastructure, especially AWS data services
Advanced understanding of relational data modeling
Strong SQL skills and Python for data wrangling
Hands-on experience withdata laketechnologies (Delta Lake, Hudi, or Iceberg)
Experience working with large-scale data warehouses (e.g., Redshift)
Experience integrating with RESTful APIs and webhooks
Familiarity with Dev Ops practices, Git version control, and clean coding standards
Exposure to monitoring and incident management tools (e.g., Cloud Watch, New Relic, Pager Duty)
Collaborative team player who values diversity and cross-functional collaborationNice to have:
Experience with Infrastructure asCode (Terraform )
Experience building and orchestrating data pipelines usingAirflowandSparkThis is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.

title: Exchange administrator
description:

Our client is looking for an experienced professional with a strong focus on the administration and support of Microsoft solutions. The ideal candidate will have solid experience managing corporate environments and working with mission-critical technologies that ensure business continuity. This role requires availability to participate in an on-call rotation and the ability to communicate in English with global teams. The position is offered under a contractor model.Responsibilities:
Administer and maintain Exchange 2016 and Office 365 environments, ensuring platform availability, stability, and performance.
Manage and optimize Active Directory environments, including security policies, authentication, and organizational structures.
Create, review, and automate processes using Power Shell to increase efficiency and operational control.
Provide advanced-level technical support and troubleshooting, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

Be available to participate in an on-call rotation schedule, responding to incidents and critical issues as needed.Requirements:
Proven experience with Exchange 2016, including maintenance, configuration, and troubleshooting.
Strong experience with Office 365, focusing on identity administration, licensing, and end-user support.
Solid hands-on experience with Active Directory, including DNS, Group Policies (GPOs), and authentication.
Advanced Power Shell skills, with the ability to build and maintain scripts for automation and problem resolution.
Conversational English is required, as the role involves interaction with international teams and stakeholders.
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment.
Availability to work under a contractor model.Preferred Skills:
Microsoft certifications related to the responsibilities of the role.
AWS experience is a plus.

title: Viral video content creator
description:
Looking for aViral Video Scriptwriter + Editorwho can consistently create viral-style performance video ads using AI tools at scale. You will own the output like it’s your channel, not a “tasks” role.
We run performance marketing campaigns and need a steady pipeline of fresh, high-converting video creatives for the US consumer.Mission for this job Own the end-to-end creative pipeline for short-form video ads:
Research the market and audience
Write scripts that hook hard and hold attention
Edit fast, clean videos using AI + simple editing tools
Ship volume, learn from results, and iterate dailyWhat success looks like First 30 daysLearn our offers, compliance guardrails, and what “good” looks like for us.
Deliver a consistent daily output of scripts + edited videos (with clear naming and organization).
Build a repeatable workflow using AI tools for speed (script, voice, visuals, editing, captions).
Show you can research the US consumer and write in natural, native-sounding English.By 90 daysShip a reliable volume of creatives every week with clear variation by hook, angle, and structure.
Consistently produce multiple “winners” per month (videos we can scale spend behind).
Maintain a simple testing system: what you tried, what worked, what failed, and what to do next.
Become independent: you don’t wait for perfect direction to move.By 12 monthsFully own a creative machine that feeds our ad accounts nonstop.
Have a documented system another creator could follow.
Be the go-to person for viral ad formats, hooks, and creative strategy across offers.What you will doWrite short-form ad scripts (UGC style, narration, simple scenes, strong hooks).
Do research (audience pains, language, objections, comments, competitor ads).
Edit videos in Cap Cut (or similar) and ship finished assets ready to launch.
Use AI tools to generate footage, b-roll, voice, captions, and variations fast.
Create lots of iterations: new hooks, new openings, new pacing, new visuals.
Organize deliverables cleanly (folders, versions, naming, notes).Who you areYou have a portfolio of viral videos, ad creatives, or short-form edits.
You have strong English and can write like a real US consumer talks.
You understand basic copywriting: hook, problem, proof, offer, CTA.
You can edit quickly in Cap Cut (or similar) and keep pacing tight.
You’ve used AI tools to create videos at scale (not just one-offs).
You move fast, learn fast, and you care more about output and results than comfort.Core valuesResourcefulness– You figure things out with minimal help.
Perfectly acceptable over perfection– Ship fast, then improve.
Constructive disagreement– Challenge ideas to get to the truth.
Kind, not nice– Honest feedback that helps people win long term.
Growth mindset– Learn from misses, don’t repeat mistakes.
Full ownership– Act like the outcome is on you.Offer Competitive pay + profit share based on skill and output, with clear growth as you produce consistent winners.Apply Email

title: Data pipeline engineer
description:
About Yipit Data:
Yipit Data is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and recently raised up to $475 M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1 B.
We analyze billions of alternative data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights on ridesharing, e-commerce marketplaces, payments, and more. Our on-demand insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on.
For three years and counting, we have been recognized as one ofInc’s Best Workplaces. We are a fast-growing technology company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners. Our offices are located in NYC, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle ,Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore. We cultivate a people-centric culture focused on mastery, ownership, and transparency.Why You Should Apply NOW:
You’ll be working with many strategic leaders within the company.
The ETL Engineering team is growing rapidly.
You’ll be challenged with a lot of big data problems.About The Role:
We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer to join our dynamic ETL Engineering team. The ideal candidate possesses 4 + yearsof software engineering experience and/or data engineering experience. An excellent candidate should have a solid understanding of Spark, SQL, and data pipeline experience. This individual will play a crucial role in supporting our strategic pipelines and optimize for reliability, efficiency, and performance.
Additionally, ETL Engineering serves as the gold standard for all other Yipit Data analyst teams, building and maintaining the core pipelines that power our products. This high-impact, high-visibility team is instrumental to the success of our rapidly growing business. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast paced strategic team and help solve some of our biggest data challenges.We expect US East Coast work hours:
Candidates should be available and willing to work during East Coast business hours (approximately 10/11am – 6/7pm EST).As Our Data Engineer You Will:
Build end-to-end data pipelines.
Help with setting best practices for our data modeling and pipeline builds.
Create documentation, architecture diagrams, and other training materials for analysts.
Become an expert at solving complex data pipeline issues using Pyspark and SQL.
Collaborate with stakeholders to incorporate business logic into our central pipelines.
Deeply learn Databricks, Airflow, and other ETL toolings.You Are Likely To Succeed If:
You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline.
You have 4+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, Data Analyst, or in other technical function.
You are excited about solving data challenges and learning new skills.
You have some understanding of working with data or building data pipelines.
You are comfortable working with large-scale datasets using Py Spark or Pandas.
You understand business needs and the rationale behind data transformations to ensure alignment with organizational goals and data strategy.
You are eager to constantly learn new technologies.
You are a self-starter who enjoys working collaboratively with stakeholders.
You have exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
Nice to have:Experience with Airflow, dbt, or equivalent.

title: Desenvolvedor de firmware sr
description:
Desenvolvedor de Firmware Sr - Foco em Microcontroladores | 100% Remota | CLTSobre nós e Resumo da posição
A Control i D é uma indústria brasileira, especializada no desenvolvimento de relógio de ponto, controle de acesso e equipamentos para automação comercial. Aqui você terá a chance de criar soluções que conectam +300 mil dispositivos Io T e impactam +1 milhão de usuários ativos, em um ambiente que valoriza inovação e liberdade tecnológica.Buscamos um Desenvolvedor de Firmware Sr para fazer parte da nossa equipe de Engenharia (focado em microcontroladores). Nossa empresa passa por um momento de crescimento e temos a missão de desenvolver novos talentos em nossa equipe. O cargo pretende desenvolver nossos produtos.O que buscamos (obrigatórios):
Senioridade comprovada em embarcados
Experiência com ESP32 + ESP-IDF em produção
Domínio de C/C++
Experiência com RTOS, com destaque para Free RTOS
Git no dia a dia (fluxo de branches, PR, code review)Habilidades desejáveis:
Conhecimento em Nordic (n RF) e/ou STM32
Conhecimento em BLE/Wi-Fi, OTA, segurança, consumo de energia, pipelines de build/testSeu papel será:
Arquitetura e desenvolvimento de firmware emC/C++
Design e implementação com Free RTOS (concorrência, sincronização, temporização, prioridades, watchdog, heap/stack tuning)
Integração de periféricos e drivers (I2 C/SPI/UART/PWM/ADC, etc.)
Power management e baixo consumo: estratégias de sleep/deep sleep, definição de wake-up sources, janelas de atividade (acorda/dorme) e gerenciamento do rádio (Wi-Fi/BLE), com medições de consumo, identificação de hotspots e melhorias de autonomia
Troubleshooting avançado: investigação de falhas intermitentes, análise de logs e core dumps, diagnóstico de resets/crashes e depuração de concorrência (deadlocks/races), com otimização de heap/stack e performance
Processo de engenharia: Git, PRs, revisão de código, padrões e documentaçãoDiferenciais da vaga:
100% remoto;
Participação ativa nos produtos desenvolvidos da área;Benefícios
100% remoto;
VR/VA sem desconto em folha;
Convênio médico com coparticipação apenas quando usar;
PLR;
Seguro de Vida;
Totalpass.

title: Accounts receivable specialist
description:
About Us:
Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.The Role:
As Vendry’sAccounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.Responsibilities:
Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.Qualifications:2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U. S.-based teams and partners.
Experience working with U. S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
Experience working remotely; able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
Based in Braziland able to work full-time remotely.Why Join Vendry:
Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.

title: Ugc coordinator
description:
UGC CoordinatorAbout Us: We are a DTC company who creates direct response ads. Our marketing team makes scripts for ads that sometimes needs UGC creators to film them. This is how you will fit into our company.About the RoleWe’re looking for a UGC Coordinator to own and lead our creator operations end-to-end.
This role is critical to keeping our content engine moving: sourcing top-tier creators, managing relationships, anticipating roadblocks, negotiating UGC costs, and ensuring deliverables flow smoothly from concept to edit-ready.You’ll be thepoint person between creators, Creative Strategists, and Operations , bringing structure, clarity, and momentum to a high-volume, fast-moving environment. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on organization, takes initiative, and solves problems independently.Key ResponsibilitiesOwn the full creator lifecycle, from sourcing and vetting to delivery and paymentBuild and maintain strong relationships with creators, ensuring clear expectations, timelines, and communicationAct as the operational hub for all creator-related projects, keeping internal tools (Notion, Slack, etc) accurate, up to date, and easy to understand at a glanceProactively track progress across all concepts and creators, identifying risks, delays, or gaps before they escalateCoordinate closely with Creative Strategists to ensure creators are fully aligned on briefs, constraints, and deliverablesEnsure seamless handoff of content to post-production, with well-organized assets and clear documentationHandle reshoots, revisions, and edge cases with a solution-first mindsetManage & negotiate creator payments and documentation in a timely and organized mannerWhat Success Looks LikeAnyone opening our tracking systems can instantly understand the status of every creator and deliverableCreators feel supported, informed, and motivated to deliver high-quality content on timeIssues are flagged early, communicated clearly, and resolved efficientlyContent moves forward without bottlenecks, confusion, or last-minute fire drillsRequired QualitiesHighly organized : able to manage multiple creators, timelines, and deliverables simultaneouslyProactive and accountable : you don’t wait to be asked—you move things forwardProblem-solver : able to find creative solutions independently before escalatingStrong communicator : clear, concise, and professional across Slack, email, and documentationDetail-oriented but execution-focused : you balance precision with speedExperience & BackgroundProven experience working with creators, talent, or influencers (UGC content preferred)Comfortable operating in afast-paced, high-output environmentExperience collaborating cross-functionally with creative, operations, and production teamsWhy This Role MattersThis role is central to how our creative machine runs. As a UGC coordinator, you ensure that ideas turn into real, usable content—on time, organized, and ready to perform. Your work directly impacts creative velocity, team alignment, and overall results.

title: Senior product experience designer (remote) - b2b healthtech saas
description:
Ongoing contract role ·10 hours per week· Remote (Brazil Based)
Flexible hours · PST time zone overlap preferred
International team across Brazil and North America
5+ years of designing Saa S web applications(required)
Hands-on product experience design - workflows, flows, wireframes
Fluent English required - written and spokenAbout the Role
We’re looking for aSenior Product Experience Designerto help shape the user experience of a Saa S web application platform that supports healthcare practitioners in delivering better patient outcomes.This role is intentionally scoped at10 hours per week , with some overlap during PST business hours required. It’s focused onsenior-level product experience design- the kind of work where judgment, clarity, and good decisions matter.This role is well suited to someone who:
enjoys focused, high-impact work,
may already have other professional commitments,
and values collaborating with a small, international team on meaningful product problems.You’ll work closely with the founder and an experienced product, design, and development team to designend-to-end product experiences— from early concepts through to wireframes ready for visual design and implementation.This is not a UI-polish role, and it’s not advisory. You will be designing the product experience itself.About Optive
We build software that helps functional medicine and healthcare practitioners deliver better patient outcomes through clearer data, better insight, and more consistent follow-up care. Optive is the next stage of this work - a patient engagement and care platform designed to support ongoing, relationship-based healthcare rather than one-off interactions.Our team works across two closely related platforms:
Optive- a patient engagement and care platform
Optimal DX- an established diagnostics and lab interpretation system used by practitioners todayYou’ll contribute experience design work acrossboth platforms , helping ensure coherence and clarity as the ecosystem evolves.Our team is fully remote and international, working across Brazil and North America, with collaboration primarily across PST time zones - often a good fit for Brazil-based team members who prefer some evening overlap.What You'll Do
Designend-to-end user journeysfor complex Saa S web applications
Translate product goals intoclear workflows, flows, and wireframes
Think through user intent, edge cases, and complexity vs. simplicity trade-offs
Create low-fidelity wireframes and experience diagrams (Figma, Miro, etc.)
Collaborate with a senior visual designer who will take your work into high-fidelity design
Challenge assumptions constructively and improve product clarity early - before development begins
Communicate clearly with an international team inEnglish , both written and spokenWhy this Role Might be a Fit
Have5+ years of experiencedesigning customer-facing Saa S products or complex web applications
Have worked on products that real customers use in production
Are comfortable designing multi-step workflows and role-based experiences
Understand how UX decisions impact usability, adoption, and real-world outcomes
Prefer focused, senior-level contribution over full-time availability
Are comfortable working independently with a high level of trust
Can overlap some working hours with PST
Communicate fluently in EnglishPreferred Background
While we care far more about what you’ve designed and shipped than your exact job title, this role is best suited to someone who has:
Designedcomplex Saa S or web applicationsused in production
Owned or heavily influencedend-to-end product experiences , not just individual screens
Worked closely with founders, product leaders, or engineering teams in small to mid-sized software companies
Designed workflows where clarity, trust, and correctness matter (e.g. healthcare, fintech, B2 B, or data-heavy products)
Been accountable for experience decisions that had real user and business impactIf your experience is primarily marketing sites, brand work, or UI-only execution, this role is unlikely to be a fit.Proof Matters
We strongly prefer candidates who can show real work, such as:
Screenshots of shipped Saa S products
Annotated flows or wireframes
Case studies explaining experience design decisions
Clear examples of problems you personally solvedWe understand NDAs exist — but we’re looking for people who canpoint to real experience design workand talk concretely about the decisions behind it.How to Apply
Apply via Linked In.Please include:
A short note about your experience designing Saa S or web applications
Links to relevant work (portfolio, screenshots, case studies)
Anything that clearly shows how you shaped the product experience

title: Electrical bim lead
description:
At Eracore, we’re committed to developing talented engineers and exposing them to some of the most exciting electrical projects in the country, while becoming the most trusted partners in the industry. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States, including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.Under strong leadership, Eracore is quickly expanding their presence inBrazil. Competitive Salary
Annual Bonus
Learning platforms that enable growth and development
Strong leadership and mentorshipRoles and Responsibilities

2+ years of hands-on experience in Electrical BIM modeling, coordination, and project delivery.
Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Electrical discipline) with strong understanding of electrical systems
Strong experience using Navisworks for clash detection, coordination, and model review.
Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, Bluebeam, and other industry tools.
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and guide juniors while maintaining high-quality output.
Ability to manage project timelines and client expectations.Preferrable
Solid understanding of U. S. construction practices, NEC codes, and electrical engineering principle.
Experience in developing BIM standards, workflows, and templates for electrical systems.
Prior experience working on Data Centers.

Experiência sólida com práticas de SRE e alta disponibilidade.

Práticas de Dev Sec Ops e segurança em nuvem.
Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas de alto impacto e arquiteturais.
Comunicação técnica eficaz para interação com times multidisciplinares.
Perfil analítico e resolutivo para troubleshooting e otimização de sistemas complexos.Diferenciais:
Experiência com Chaos Engineering e testes de resiliência.
Vivência com Fin Ops e otimização de custos na nuvem.

Portuguese + English fluencyNon-Negotiables:

title: Principal ai engineer - ai in healthcare
description:
WHO WE AREWe are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:
Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
Automated coding and billing optimization
Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials
Seamless compliance with value-based care requirementsJoin us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOUThis is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.KEY RESPONSIBILITIESVery hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!1. Build and Refine AI Products
Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy
Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy3. Own the Development Lifecycle
Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement
Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge baseREQUIRED EXPERTISE1. Technical Skills
Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, Open AI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (Postgre SQL)2. Mindset & Approach
Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing3. Highly Valued Qualifications
Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, Git Hub Copilot, or similar
Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (Lang Chain, Llama Index, or similar)
Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle managementHealthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.WHAT WE OFFER1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity
Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale2. Professional Excellence
Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside3. Work-Life Integration
Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily
Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainabilityREADY FOR THE CHALLENGE?If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

title: Graphic designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!Yeah, you heard that right.Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Graphic Designer to join our growing team!About UsDingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!Key Responsibilities
Create visually appealing designs for various platforms, including digital, print, social media, and branding.
Use AI tools and design software to streamline the design process, generate ideas, and automate repetitive tasks, ensuring fresh and innovative results.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, content, etc.) to deliver high-quality design solutions that align with brand guidelines and project goals.
Work on design projects from start to finish, ensuring designs are on-brand, on-time, and meet all requirements.
Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends, tools, and AI technologies to keep your work innovative and relevant.
Edit and optimize designs for various media, ensuring the best quality and user experience across devices.Qualifications
Strong experience as a graphic designer, with a portfolio showcasing your skills in visual design, creativity, and problem-solving.
Proficiency in design software like Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, In Design), Canva, Figma, or similar tools.
Proficiency in Microsoft programs (Power Point and Word)
Familiarity with AI-powered design tools (such as Chat GPT, Gemini, Nanobanana, Midjourney, Firefly, Freepik AI, etc.) and an eagerness to explore new AI technologies.
Understanding of digital design principles for social media, websites, and other online platforms.
Understanding of small-scale and large-scale print materials (such as business cards, flyers, menus, conference collateral, merchandise, banners, backdrops, etc.)
Ability to work efficiently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple design projects simultaneously.
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with team members.
A working level of written and spoken EnglishOur operating hours are 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST, Monday to Friday.Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

description:

title: Especialista azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.Oportunidade: Especialista Azure
A PSM Company busca um(a) profissional altamente qualificado(a) para atuar em soluções avançadas na plataformaMicrosoft Azure. A posição exige sólida experiência em arquitetura, governança e operação de ambientes corporativos em nuvem, com ênfase emAzure Network , infraestrutura e mecanismos de segurança.Responsabilidades
Estruturar arquiteturas em Azure envolvendo Compute, Network, Storage, Monitoring e Security, garantindo desempenho, confiabilidade e conformidade.
Implementar ambientes utilizando VMs, VMSS, AKS, App Services, Functions, pipelines de imagem e automações baseadas em Bicep/Terraform.

Aplicar práticas de segurança baseadas em Zero Trust, controle de acesso, criptografia, Key Vault, Defender for Cloud e políticas corporativas.
Apoiar diretrizes de governança, otimização de custos, nomenclatura, conformidade e padrões arquiteturais.

Domínio comprovado emAzure Network(mandatório).
Conhecimento aprofundado em virtualização, dimensionamento, containers, disponibilidade, continuidade e workloads especializados.
Experiência em automação, gestão de configuração, atualização e pipelines de provisionamento.
Competência para operar ferramentas de monitoramento e execução de análises avançadas.
Sólida compreensão de identidade, políticas, governança e modelos de segurança.
Vivência em ambientes híbridos e de grande escala.Contratação CLT

· Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;

· Convênio com Farmácia;

title: Especialista azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.Oportunidade: Especialista Azure
A PSM Company busca um(a) profissional altamente qualificado(a) para atuar em soluções avançadas na plataformaMicrosoft Azure. A posição exige sólida experiência em arquitetura, governança e operação de ambientes corporativos em nuvem, com ênfase emAzure Network , infraestrutura e mecanismos de segurança.Responsabilidades
Estruturar arquiteturas em Azure envolvendo Compute, Network, Storage, Monitoring e Security, garantindo desempenho, confiabilidade e conformidade.
Implementar ambientes utilizando VMs, VMSS, AKS, App Services, Functions, pipelines de imagem e automações baseadas em Bicep/Terraform.
Projetar topologias de rede complexas, incluindo VNets, Subnets, NSG/ASG, Private Link, Application Gateway, Firewall, Front Door, Load Balancer e conectividade híbrida via VPN ou Express Route.
Administrar soluções de armazenamento, contemplando Blob, ADLS Gen2, Azure Files, discos gerenciados, replicação, políticas de ciclo de vida e mecanismos de proteção.
Operar ferramentas de observabilidade, configurando logs, métricas, alertas, diagnósticos, KQL e integrações automatizadas.
Aplicar práticas de segurança baseadas em Zero Trust, controle de acesso, criptografia, Key Vault, Defender for Cloud e políticas corporativas.
Apoiar diretrizes de governança, otimização de custos, nomenclatura, conformidade e padrões arquiteturais.
Atuar em integrações com ambientes on-premise, contemplando DNS, DHCP, File Server, clustering e recursos relacionados.
Requisitos Técnicos
Domínio comprovado emAzure Network(mandatório).
Conhecimento aprofundado em virtualização, dimensionamento, containers, disponibilidade, continuidade e workloads especializados.
Experiência em automação, gestão de configuração, atualização e pipelines de provisionamento.
Competência para operar ferramentas de monitoramento e execução de análises avançadas.
Sólida compreensão de identidade, políticas, governança e modelos de segurança.
Vivência em ambientes híbridos e de grande escala.Contratação CLT
Contrato híbrido para viagens esporádicas - no mais, a atuação é remota.O que oferecemos?· Contratação CLT;
· Vale Refeição;
· Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
· Auxílio creche;
· Convênio com Farmácia;
· Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
· Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
· Seguro de Vida.O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas.

title: Arquiteto de software (foco em .net & angular)
description:
Sobre a Redspark:
Somos uma consultoria tech com DNA inovador e foco em soluções digitais robustas e escaláveis. Com +10 anos de estrada e centenas de projetos realizados para empresas nacionais e multinacionais. O sucesso de nossos projetos se ancora na visão de que num ambiente de negócios em constante evolução as soluções precisam equilibrar altos níveis de excelência e confiabilidade com inovação, agilidade e flexibilidade. Focamos na criação de experiências digitais para os mais diversos mercados, em especial aqueles em que as soluções digitais já fazem parte do processo de interação com seus stakeholders. O nome redspark é alusão à nossa busca pelo insight, pelo caminho que não foi pensado e pelo melhor resultado para o negócio. Perseguir aquela fagulha de criatividade nos permite imaginar soluções muito melhores e superar os resultados desejados.Desafio da posição:
Estamos buscando um Arquiteto de Software com perfil hands-on, para ser a referência da squad. Vai atuar desde a arquitetura e desenvolvimento até as decisões estratégicas de tecnologia, liderando um time engajado e colaborativo.Responsabilidades:
Ser a referência técnica da equipe, apoiando na tomada de decisão e resolução de desafios complexos.
Atuar no design e evolução da arquitetura de software com foco em Clean Code, SOLID e escalabilidade.
Codar de ponta a ponta, tanto nobackend (. NET Core)quanto nofrontend (Angular)
Promover boas práticas de engenharia:testes automatizados, segurança, performance, CI/CD, monitoramento.
Trabalhar em parceria com POs, Designers e demais stakeholders para transformar requisitos em soluções robustas.
Apoiar a adoção de tecnologias, frameworks e ferramentas alinhadas ao negócio.
Aplicar práticas de Dev Ops e Cloud para garantir eficiência, resiliência e escalabilidade.Requisitos Técnicos:
Backend (. NET):
C# e. NET Core (API RESTful, Microservices, async programming, DI, Middleware).
ORMs: Entity Framework Core / Dapper.
Bancos relacionais (SQL Server, Postgre SQL).
Experiência com mensageria (Rabbit MQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, AWS SQS).
Conhecimento em autenticação/autorização, Identity Providers.
Vivência em modernização de sistemas legados (ex: Web Forms).
Frontend (Angular):
Angular (experiência com múltiplas versões é um diferencial).
Autenticação/autorização no frontend.
Route Guards, Lazy Loading e Interceptors.
Cloud & Dev Ops:
Experiência com AWS, Azure ou GCP
CI/CD na prática
Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform)
Containers: Docker e Kubernetes⭐Diferenciais:
Experiência em ambientes multicloud.
Vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade (Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, ELK, Dynatrace).
Certificações em Cloud,. NET ou Arquitetura.
Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, etc.).Formato:
Contratação PJ.
100% remoto.
Ambiente colaborativo, tech-driven e com muito espaço pra protagonismo.

title: Senior devops engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges, collaborate on an interesting product, be up to date with the latest technology, and contribute to taking our product to market? Then keep reading!Yes, tell me more…
fullinfo is a startup B2 B data services software company.
We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.
The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and Graph QL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s.We are currently hiring aSenior Dev Ops Engineer with AWS CDK knowledgefor an initial 12-month B2 B Contract on a remote basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (EDA architecture) and Type Script and willing to pick up new technologies as needed.Responsibilities:
Participate in our Dev Ops team
Ensure the quality of our AWS infrastructure
Develop and review infrastructure code that enhances performance and cost efficiency
Ensure seamless integration of all AWS services within our architecture
Optimize the infrastructure for continuous scalability
Drive ongoing improvements in CI/CD pipelines
Collaborate with development teams, the CTO, and technical leadsRequirements:
A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
A minimum of 6 years relevant experience working in Dev Ops roles
Hands-on experience with Type Script and AWS CDK
Coding experience in implementing business features
Familiarity with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, Cloud Front, Event Bridge, App Sync, Dynamo Db, Open Search
Business-level proficiency in EnglishThe successful candidate will…
Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
Take ownership and be accountable for their work
Be eager to work on various aspects of our cloud infrastructure in a generalist role
Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup
Have experience supporting other teams in implementing AWS solutions
Adopt a proactive, hands-on approachWhat can you expect from us?
To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward.
Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together?A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a highly motivated team.
A start-up environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software.Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:
Quality:At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. Our product is beautiful inside and outside. How do we achieve this? By always asking ourselves “Is this right?” or “Does this make sense?”.
Problem Solving:We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Senior .net developer
description:
Job Title:Senior Software Engineer (Contractor)
Job Type:Full-time (Remote)
Pay:R$20,000.00 – R$22,000.00 per monthPosition Overview
We are seeking aSenior Software Engineer contractorto join our U. S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.
In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to ourAgile workflow via Azure Dev Ops. You will begin withautomated testingandpeer reviews , expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. Your role will evolve based on your strengths and our needs — all while adhering torigorous coding and security standards.Key Responsibilities
1. Product Design & Development
Collaborate with stakeholders to design software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancing existing codebases (opportunities starting around months 3–4).
2. Testing & Quality
Design and implement automated End-to-End (E2 E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability — with a strong focus during your first 6–9 months.
3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support
Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.
4. Agile Collaboration
Actively contribute to2-week sprintsand6-week release cycles(3 sprints per release).
Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).
5. Communication & Coordination
Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.Qualifications
Experience
8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.
Technical Skills
Proficiency inC# ASP. NET (. NET 8)for web applications and APIs.
Experience with. NET MAUIandBlazor Web Application (. NET 8)for mobile and web development.
Familiarity withMicrosoft Azure(Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure Dev Ops).
Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.
Soft Skills
Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.
Preferred
Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.g., HIPAA).
Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.How We Work
Agile Workflow:2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
Code Standards:Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
Tools:Azure Dev Ops, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
Team Culture:Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

title: Accounting manager
description:
TGG Way Accounting Manager
Location:Fully Remote working for US-Based ClientsAbout Us
We are a dynamic and growing accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. title: Data engineer
description:
What is Teachable?
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.
Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!About your Team
At Teachable, our Data Team is all about getting things done with minimal overhead. We work closely together, sharing ideas, designing efficient systems, and building a robust data platform that supports the entire organization. Reporting to the Data Engineering Manager, you’ll take the lead on key initiatives, from optimizing our data platform to shaping the future of our events pipeline and ETL processes.
Our data infrastructure is primarily hosted on AWS. We leverage managed Airflow for orchestration, managed Kafka for event collection, Redshift for analytics, and S3 for data lake storage. Working as a Mid-level Analyst, you will partner with Finance to build metrics and data models that facilitate data exploration and business logic integration, supporting the continuous improvement of the data platform.The Impact You'll Make
In this role, you'll be at the heart of our data strategy, taking ownership of mission-critical infrastructure that supports teams across the company. You’ll also have the opportunity to make strategic recommendations on how we can evolve our data platform to stay ahead of the curve.What You’ll Do
Partner with Engineering and Product teams on high-impact initiatives.
Design and implement robust data pipelines using AWS services.
Enhance event collection, queueing, and processing mechanisms.
Build and refine meaningful alerts with automated corrective actions.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues, ensuring system reliability and stability.
Architect scalable data products with long-term vision and efficiency in mind.
Identify and resolve complex technical challenges involving system integration, infrastructure, and software bugs.About You
2-3+ years of experience in Data Engineering
Fluency in English is required
Strong knowledge of modern data engineering practices and software engineering principles
Solid experience with cloud infrastructure, especially AWS data services
Advanced understanding of relational data modeling
Strong SQL skills and Python for data wrangling
Hands-on experience withdata laketechnologies (Delta Lake, Hudi, or Iceberg)
Experience working with large-scale data warehouses (e.g., Redshift)
Experience integrating with RESTful APIs and webhooks
Familiarity with Dev Ops practices, Git version control, and clean coding standards
Exposure to monitoring and incident management tools (e.g., Cloud Watch, New Relic, Pager Duty)
Collaborative team player who values diversity and cross-functional collaborationNice to have:
Experience with Infrastructure asCode (Terraform )
Experience building and orchestrating data pipelines usingAirflowandSparkThis is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack(go e java)
description:
Por que ingressar na Exadel
Ingresse em uma organização global de engenharia que valoriza o trabalho artesanal, a colaboração e a melhoria contínua. Na Exadel, você trabalhará com tecnologias modernas, criará sistemas escaláveis e contribuirá para soluções utilizadas em ambientes de alto impacto e missão crítica. Priorizamos código limpo, padrões de engenharia robustos e uma cultura de apoio e orientada para o crescimento.
Visão geral do cargo
E stamos procurando um engenheiro back-end (Golang/Java) sênior ou plenopara projetar, construir e dar suporte a serviços de back-end nativos da nuvem. Esta função é ideal para alguém que gosta de resolver desafios técnicos complexos, se destaca em arquiteturas distribuídas e trabalha em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais de produto e engenharia.
O que você fará
• Desenvolver, aprimorar e manter APIs e serviços de back-end de alto desempenho usando Golang e Java (Quarkus).
• Construir soluções escaláveis, resilientes e sustentáveis para ambientes distribuídos e com prioridade na nuvem.
• Contribuir para o projeto arquitetônico e aplicar as melhores práticas de engenharia (código limpo, observabilidade, testes, confiabilidade).
• Colaborar estreitamente com as equipes de Produto, Arquitetura e SRE para oferecer recursos refinados e confiáveis.
• Otimizar pipelines de CI/CD, desempenho e integrações entre serviços.
• Garantir os mais altos níveis de segurança, qualidade e desempenho em todos os resultados.
Requisitos mandatorios:
• Sólida experiência com Golang.
• Experiência com Java 8+.
• Experiência prática com AWS (Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, API Gateway, Cloud Watch, IAM, etc.).
• Experiencia com microsserviços, arquitetura distribuída e sistemas de mensagens (Kafka, SQS).
• Sólido conhecimento de CI/CD, Git e práticas modernas de implantação/controle de versão.
• Capacidade de analisar, compreender e resolver problemas complexos com calma e eficácia.
Diferenciais
• Experiencia com framework quarkus.
• Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Cloud Formation).
• Proficiência ou conhecimento prático de Python (scripts de automação, módulos, microsserviços).
• Experiência de trabalho em ambientes de alta criticidade ou alta disponibilidade.
• Conhecimento de ferramentas de observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry).
• Abordagem colaborativa e comunicativa, com vontade de compartilhar conhecimento.

title: Executive search consultant
description:
About Gold & Aron:
Gold & Aron Conseil is a boutique executive search firm with a 20+ year track record of placing top-tier talent in the Technology and Financial Services industries across the Americas and Europe.About the Role
We are hiring an Executive Search Senior Associate to support Gold & Aron CEO and COO across high-impact searches in Technology and Financial Services in a premium boutique environment. The role blends deep research, pipeline development, and end-to-end recruiting for select mid-level roles. You’ll help build the engine that enables leadership to focus on client strategy and firm growth.WHAT YOU WILL DOCandidate Research & Sourcing for senior level searches (60%)
Build and manage strong candidate pipelines across multiple concurrent searches.
Active search: Conduct structured research, market mapping using several tech tools including Linkedin, AI tools and own data base.
Passive search: Source, screen applicants
Lead candidate scoring, initial candidate assessmentEnd to end Recruiting for selected mid level searches (30%)
Build and manage candidate pipeline
Conduct first-round screens to assess fit and motivation.
Prepare concise candidate summaries and search updates.
Support client communications and progress check-ins.
Coordinate interviews and every other step of the hiring process.Business Development Support (10%)
Research companies, markets, and potential clients
Build prospect lists and market intelligence for the CEO and COO.
Bring new ideas, new BD initiatives for the companyIDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE
3–7+ years in research, consulting, finance, tech, recruiting, or similar fields.
Experience in or recruiting for Tech or Financial Services is a strong plus.
Advanced English + Native Portuguese is a must. Spanish is a strong plus.
Analytical, structured thinker with strong organization and attention to detail.
Comfortable with ambiguity; bias for action; strong ownership mindset.
Bachelor’s degree mandatory.
Location: Brazil remote. Preference for São Paulo, SP.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack(go e java)
description:
Por que ingressar na Exadel
Ingresse em uma organização global de engenharia que valoriza o trabalho artesanal, a colaboração e a melhoria contínua. Na Exadel, você trabalhará com tecnologias modernas, criará sistemas escaláveis e contribuirá para soluções utilizadas em ambientes de alto impacto e missão crítica. Priorizamos código limpo, padrões de engenharia robustos e uma cultura de apoio e orientada para o crescimento.
Visão geral do cargo
E stamos procurando um engenheiro back-end (Golang/Java) sênior ou plenopara projetar, construir e dar suporte a serviços de back-end nativos da nuvem. Esta função é ideal para alguém que gosta de resolver desafios técnicos complexos, se destaca em arquiteturas distribuídas e trabalha em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais de produto e engenharia.
O que você fará
• Desenvolver, aprimorar e manter APIs e serviços de back-end de alto desempenho usando Golang e Java (Quarkus).
• Construir soluções escaláveis, resilientes e sustentáveis para ambientes distribuídos e com prioridade na nuvem.
• Contribuir para o projeto arquitetônico e aplicar as melhores práticas de engenharia (código limpo, observabilidade, testes, confiabilidade).
• Colaborar estreitamente com as equipes de Produto, Arquitetura e SRE para oferecer recursos refinados e confiáveis.
• Otimizar pipelines de CI/CD, desempenho e integrações entre serviços.
• Garantir os mais altos níveis de segurança, qualidade e desempenho em todos os resultados.
Requisitos mandatorios:
• Sólida experiência com Golang.
• Experiência com Java 8+.
• Experiência prática com AWS (Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, API Gateway, Cloud Watch, IAM, etc.).
• Experiencia com microsserviços, arquitetura distribuída e sistemas de mensagens (Kafka, SQS).
• Sólido conhecimento de CI/CD, Git e práticas modernas de implantação/controle de versão.
• Capacidade de analisar, compreender e resolver problemas complexos com calma e eficácia.
Diferenciais
• Experiencia com framework quarkus.
• Experiência com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Cloud Formation).
• Proficiência ou conhecimento prático de Python (scripts de automação, módulos, microsserviços).
• Experiência de trabalho em ambientes de alta criticidade ou alta disponibilidade.
• Conhecimento de ferramentas de observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry).
• Abordagem colaborativa e comunicativa, com vontade de compartilhar conhecimento.

title: Business developer for social media
description:
As Blueclip, we started our journey to bring the most creative minds and the know-how together to deliver great works. Our current search is a Business Developer for identifying and developing strategic opportunities across major social media platforms.This role sits at the intersection of business development, content partnerships, and M&A opportunities within the creator economy.As a Business Developer, you will be responsible for identifying high-potential content channels, engaging with creators and channel owners, evaluating monetization opportunities, and structuring commercial partnerships that support our company’s growth strategy.Key Responsibilities:
Identify high-revenue potential You Tube, Facebook, and Snapchat channels aligned with the business goals
Engage with content creators and/or channel owners to assess the value and potential of their channels
Develop and present commercial proposals to creators and channel owners
Onboard new partners (creators or channel owners) into the company’s operational processes
Explore and analyze new opportunities across social platforms to accelerate company growth
Collaborate closely with platform managers, the data/strategy team, and company executives (CEOs) to align business opportunities with strategic prioritiesIdeal Candidate Profile:
Excellent English communication skills, written and spoken
Strong understanding of the creator economy and social media content monetization
Genuine interest in digital content and the evolution of social platforms
Proven negotiation and deal-making abilities
Ability to craft compelling commercial offers and proposals
Strong autonomy, organization, and project management skills
Experience in business development, partnerships, or M&A related to digital media or entertainmentIf you think everything suits you, hit the apply button!

title: Diretor (A) De Arte
description:
Sobre a HIKE

A HIKE é uma Creative Company que inspira & transforma pessoas e marcas através do branding, design, produção de conteúdo digital, audiovisual e ativações. Atuamos desde os primeiros passos da jornada de uma marca até a concepção de grandes projetos para gigantes globais como AMBEV, Red Bull e Unilever.

Sobre a vaga

Você será responsável por liderar a direção de arte dos projetos de Branding da HIKE traduzindo estratégia de marca em sistemas visuais fortes, consistentes e aplicáveis no mundo real. Na prática, você é quem puxa a régua de qualidade do design, conduz rotas criativas, refina soluções até o nível máximo de acabamento e garante entregas impecáveis de design.

Nível do cargo

Sênior

Responsabilidades
  • Direção de arte de marcas: Liderar o desenvolvimento de sistemas visuais (identidades e key visuals), transformando insumos de estratégia (posicionamento, arquitetura, territórios, tom) em soluções visuais claras, proprietárias e autênticas.
  • Criação e evolução de identidades: Criar identidades completas (logo, paleta, tipografia, patterns, ilustrações, linguagem fotográfica e motion guidelines quando aplicável) e evoluir marcas existentes com consistência.
  • Packaging e design de key visuals: Desenvolver e/ou direcionar projetos de embalagem e key visuals.
  • Exploração criativa: Conduzir rotas criativas com clareza e repertório, testando caminhos antes de “fechar” a solução.
  • Padrão de craft: Ser referência de acabamento (tipografia, composição, hierarquia, cor, grid, micro detalhes), elevando o nível do time.
  • Gestão do time e/ou freelas: Direcionar e revisar entregas do time e/ou freelas, garantindo coerência com o sistema e nível de craft.
  • Feedback e iteração: Organizar rodadas de revisão (interno/cliente), filtrar feedback, priorizar ajustes e conduzir refinamentos sem perder o conceito.
  • Apresentação e defesa: Apresentar rotas e soluções com argumentação, critério e segurança;
    conduzir alinhamentos visuais e direcionar decisões.
Requisitos:
  • Portfólio robusto com projetos de branding (identidades e key visuals).
  • Experiência em conduzir rotas criativas e refinar soluções.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de design (Adobe CC).
  • Conhecimento sólido em construção de sistemas visuais.
  • Capacidade de traduzir estratégia de marca em decisões visuais (para além da estética).
  • Experiência em apresentar e defender trabalho para clientes, gerindo feedbacks com maturidade.

title: Perfusionista
description:
Operar máquinas de circulação extracorpórea, em cirurgias torácicas, cardíacas, de transplante de órgãos, de revascularização periférica e terapias de oxigenação por membrana extracorpórea (ECMO), a fim de garantir a manutenção das atividades vitais dos organismos dos pacientes, durante a realização das cirurgias. Assegurar o funcionamento adequado dos equipamentos e a manutenção da função cardiovascular dos pacientes, durante os procedimentos, permitindo que os cirurgiões realizem as intervenções necessárias, com segurança.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Participar da implantação de projetos de perfusão;
  • Realizar e validar testes de protótipos;
  • Realizar montagem de materiais descartáveis nos equipamentos de perfusão;
  • Operar máquinasde circulação extracorpórea (CEC), em cirurgias torácicas, cardíacas, de transplante de órgãos e de revascularização periférica, a fim de garantir a manutenção das atividades vitais dos organismos dos pacientes, durante a realização das cirurgias;
  • Operar equipamentos de Oxigenação por Membrana Extracorpórea (ECMO);
  • Controlar a manutenção da função cardiovascular e outras atividades vitais dos organismos dos pacientes (oxigenação do sangue, circulação sanguínea, temperatura corporal, pressão arterial, entre outros), durante os procedimentos;
  • Assegurar o funcionamento adequado dos equipamentos de perfusão, permitindo que os cirurgiões realizem as intervenções necessárias, com segurança;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas e procedimentos técnicos de qualidade e de segurança do trabalho;
  • Utilizar técnicas assépticas, para lidar adequadamente com o manuseio de materiais estéreis e biológicos;
  • Zelar pelo estado funcional (guarda, segurança e devolução) dos equipamentos da empresa;
  • Registrar informações dos procedimentos cirúrgicos realizados, em aplicativos/sistemas corporativos, para que as equipes de Assistência de Vendas e Faturamento, possam dar seguimento às etapas internas;
  • Apresentar Comunicados de uso de OPME (fichas de sala), devidamente preenchidos e assinados, para a equipe de Assistência de Vendas, conforme processo interno;
  • Registrar, junto a equipe de Qualidade, Não Conformidades ocorridas em procedimentos, como o mal funcionamento de equipamentos e dispositivos;
    atrasos, troca de tamanhos e/ou especificidades, etc., conforme processo interno;
  • Realizar a troca de dosímetros digitais e EPIs (quando pertinente), periodicamente e cumprir com as normas de utilização, conforme orientações da equipe de SESMT;
  • Preencher relatórios de controle e outros necessários, conforme solicitação da Gestão.

title: Global Process Data Consultant/Lead
description:
Job Description :

Global Process Data Consultant / Lead Duration : 7 months

100% Remote opportunity within USA and Brazil

Position Purpose

Currently undertaking several large-scale global transformation projects. Each of which requires conversion and migration of data, and ongoing process (reference, conditional, configuration, transactional, and etc..) data management. We are seeking experienced SAP S / 4HANA Functional Process Data Experts to support a global greenfield S / 4HANA implementation across all value streams (RTR, PTD, PLM, STP, OTC…business processes. This role is critical to ensuring that business data is fit-for-purpose, standardized, governed, and ready to enable successful process design, system build, migration, and adoption.

The Functional Process Data Expert will act as the bridge between business process owners, functional SAP teams, and the data enablement organization, ensuring that data requirements are fully embedded into solution design and execution.

Key ResponsibilitiesData Enablement & Solution Design
  • Partner with global and regional business stakeholders to define data requirements aligned to standardized value stream processes.
  • Translate business process designs into clear master and transactional data definitions for S / 4HANA.
  • Support template design by ensuring consistent data models, attributes, and hierarchies across geographies.
  • Validate data readiness for end-to-end process execution (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return) Functional Process.
Data Ownership Responsibilities
  • Defining data objects, attributes, and mandatory fields.
  • Supporting business rules, validations, and derivations.
  • Aligning data structures to SAP best practices and industry standards.
Data Migration & Readiness
  • Support data cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization activities.
  • Define and validate data mapping rules from legacy systems to S / 4HANA.
  • Participate in mock conversions, data loads, and reconciliation activities.
  • Ensure data quality thresholds are met prior to cutover.
Data Governance & Standards
  • Support the establishment and enforcement of global data standards and policies.
  • Work closely with Master Data and Data Governance teams.
  • Help define roles, ownership, and stewardship models for value stream data.
  • Contribute to data quality monitoring and remediation processes.
  • Support functional and integrated testing with a strong focus on data accuracy.
  • Validate business scenarios using migrated and created data.
  • Support cutover planning and execution from a data perspective.
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization.
Required QualificationsExperience
  • 5+ years of SAP functional experience with strong data focus.
  • Hands‑on experience with SAP S / 4HANA (greenfield preferred).
  • Proven involvement in large‑scale, global ERP implementations.
  • Deep understanding of value stream business processes and related data objects.
  • Experience supporting data migration, cleansing, and validation.
Technical & Functional Skills
  • Strong knowledge of SAP master data objects (e.G., Material, Vendor / Business Partner, BOM, Routings, Pricing, Customer, etc.).
  • Understanding of S / 4HANA data model changes vs. ECC.
  • Experience working with SAP MDG or similar governance tools preferred.
  • Familiarity with data migration tools (e.G., SAP Migration Cockpit, LVM, ETL tools).
  • Ability to read and interpret functional specs and data models.
Soft Skills
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work across global, cross‑functional teams.
  • Detail‑oriented with strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast‑paced transformation environment.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in manufacturing, building materials, or asset‑intensive industries.
  • Prior role as Functional Data Lead or Data Domain Lead.
  • Experience defining global templates and harmonized data models.
  • Knowledge of data quality tools and metrics.

title: estagiário nutrição
description:
Somos uma instituição que tem a tradição e inovação como pilares. A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino e pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.

A instituição secular, que sempre esteve a serviço do bem da população baiana, tem sua gestão orientada estrategicamente para que colaboradores e voluntários sigam a mesma base filosófica e, com isso, a sociedade possa compreender a personalidade da entidade.

Negócio: Cuidar da pessoa e estimular a sua dignidade

Missão: Desenvolver ações de solidariedade nas áreas de saúde, educação, cultura e ação social inspiradas nos ideais de misericórdia.

Visão: Ser reconhecida como a melhor e mais abrangente instituição filantrópica do Brasil.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Acompanhar a evolução nutricional dos pacientes.

Elaborar e revisar planos alimentares sob supervisão do nutricionista.

Auxiliar na triagem nutricional e classificação de risco.

Acompanhar rotinas de dietoterapia (injeção de dietas enterais, adequação de dietas hospitalares, consistências, restrições).

Registrar informações no prontuário.

Elaboração de relatórios, planilhas e registros.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Nutrição;
  • A partir do 4° e até o 7° período.

Informações adicionais

  • 30 horas semanais.

Ficamos felizes pelo seu interesse em participar da nossa equipe de colaboradores, que já soma aproximadamente 5.500 funcionários.

Antes de sabermos mais sobre suas características profissionais, convidamos você a conhecer um pouco da história da Santa Casa da

Bahia, instituição filantrópica que se propõe ao objetivo de ajudar aos mais necessitados.

Foi no ano de 1549, quando Tomé de Sousa ocupava o posto de governador-geral do Brasil, que foi construída uma casa de taipa e palha, no Centro Histórico de Salvador, que por cerca de 200 anos abrigou o Hospital de Caridade, primeiro hospital do Estado da Bahia, sendo o único a prestar assistência aos baianos na época.

Somente em 30 de julho de 1893 foi construído o Hospital Santa Izabel (HSI), no bairro de Nazaré, em Salvador, desativando a antiga

unidade de saúde que funcionava no Pelourinho. O prédio do primeiro hospital passou a ser a sede administrativa da Santa Casa da Bahia e, em 2006, se tornou o Museu da Misericórdia.

A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de

serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino, pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.

title: Digital Media Planner
description:
About the Team/Role

WEX is seeking a strategic and results-oriented Media Planning Manager to join our Digital Media team. You will play a vital role in developing and managing comprehensive media plans for our Mobility product. 

How you'll make an impact

  • Assist in the development and activation of SEM & programmatic and paid social digital media plans and campaign work for multiple lines of business.

  • Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable insights.

  • Strong communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • A passion for digital marketing and a commitment to continuous learning.

Join WEX Inc. and play a key role in driving the success of our diverse brand portfolio
